title: Not quite what I was expecting
text: Not quite what I was expecting. These curtain have potential but they were too short by 2-3” according to the size I ordered. It’s a heavy material which will definitely stop drafts but Brookstone needs to get the measurements correct. They colors were off too. The green was very dull and felt like an office curtain. The tan color was off too. It’s was a return.

product_metadata.title: Brookstone Harvey Mid Century Modern Room Darkening Rod Pocket Window Curtains w/Liner for Bedroom (Single Panel), 50" x 63", Green
features: LIGHT BLOCKING LEVEL - Brookstone Room Darkening Curtains block out most of the sun's light from shining in, allowing just a small amount to pass through will providing you full privacy. Perfect for your living room, bedroom, kids room, nursery and more
ENERGY EFFICIENT - The Bonded Fleece Layer & Draft Blocking technology provides an insulated barrier against summer heat and winter chill to balance your room temperature and save on energy bills

STYLE & LUXURY - The perfect marriage between Mid-Century Modern style and high functionality - Keep out unwanted cold air in colder months and keep in cool air in warmer climates without compromising the luxury and style of naturally flowing draperies

EASY SET UP & SIMPLE SLIDE TECHNOLOGY - Rod Pocket design fits any standard or decorative rod for quick and easy installation. Simple Slide technology allows for opening and closing the curtains with ease (Recommended with a 2-inch rod, sold separately)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - Machine washable in gentle cycle and cold water, do not bleach. Warm iron and tumble dry at low temperatures
description: Bring style and extreme functionality into your space with the Brookstone Harvey Window Curtain Panel. The woven solid, lightly textured fabric of this panel is sure to add a transitional decorative flare to any space. Bonded fleece layer to help keep out unwanted cold air in colder months and keep in cool air in warmer climates. Brookstone offers multiple lines of functional curtains that provide privacy and draft blocking capabilities without sacrificing the latest looks in window fashion.  Each panel features a 50-inch width and is available in 63-inch, 84-inch, 95-inch, and 108-inch lengths to fit a variety of window spaces. 4-inch rod pocket with simple slide feature are recommended with a 2-inch rod. Sold as a single panel. 100% Polyester. Rod sold separately.
